identificationModule.briefTitle: Arsenic Trioxide TACE and Intravenous Administration in Unresectable Hepatocellular Carcinoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: Arsenic Trioxide TACE and Intravenous Administration Compared With Arsenic Trioxide TACE Alone in Unresectable Hepatocellular Carcinoma: a Randomized, Parallel, Controlled, Multi-center Clinical Study

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether compared with arsenic trioxide TACE alone, arsenic trioxide TACE and intravenous administration could further prolong the overall survival.

armGroups.label: Arsenic trioxide TACE
armGroups.description: Arsenic trioxide TACE: arsenic trioxide powder 20mg dissolved in lipiodol(the dosage of lipiodol is decided according to the volume of the target lesion)is used for transcatheter arterial chemoembolization(TACE). TACE will be repeated after 4\~6 weeks if it is necessary according to the assessment from imaging modalities.

armGroups.label: Arsenic trioxide TACE+IV
armGroups.description:
1. Arsenic trioxide TACE: arsenic trioxide powder 20mg dissolved in lipiodol(the dosage of lipiodol is decided according to the volume of the target lesion)is used for transcatheter arterial chemoembolization(TACE). TACE will be repeated after 4\~6 weeks if it is necessary according to the assessment from imaging modalities.
2. Arsenic trioxide intravenous infusion: arsenic trioxide powder 0.15mg/Kg/d(maxim 10mg/d) dissolved in 250ml 0.9% sodium chloride solution is used for intravenous infusion.Every course will last for 3 weeks and the next course will be continued after 1 week suspension.Intravenous infusion will be suspended 3 days before and 7\~14 days after TACE.

interventions.description: Arsenic trioxide intravenous infusion: arsenic trioxide powder 0.15mg/Kg/d(maxim 10mg/d) dissolved in 250ml 0.9%NaCl solution is used for intravenous infusion.Every course will last for 3 weeks and the next course will be continued after 1 week suspension.Intravenous infusion will be suspended 3 days before and 7\~14 days after TACE.

interventions.name: lipiodol
interventions.description: Lipiodol is used to dissolve arsenic trioxide for TACE,with the dosage decided according to the volume of the target lesion.

interventions.name: NaCl solution
interventions.description: 250ml NaCl solution is used to dissolve the arsenic trioxide for intravenous infusion.

primaryOutcomes.description: Time to progression in our study is defined as the time from a patient's enrollment to the time for disease progression (according to Recist1.1).
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of randomization until the date of first documented progression or date of death from any cause, whichever came first, assessed up to 2 years.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Overall survival in our study is defined as the time from a patient's enrollment to the time for death.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of randomization until the date of first documented progression or date of death from any cause, whichever came first, assessed up to 2 years.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Quality of life is assessed according to the FACT-Hep questionnaire.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of randomization until the date of first documented progression or date of death from any cause, whichever came first, assessed up to 2 years.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Safety of our treatment plan will be assessed according to the Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events（CTCAE） 3.0
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of randomization until the date of first documented progression or date of death from any cause, whichever came first, assessed up to 2 years.

otherOutcomes.description: Extrahepatic metastasis rate is defined as the proportion of the extrahepatic metastasis for patients who were absent of extrahepatic metastasis at enrollment.
otherOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of randomization until the date of first documented progression or date of death from any cause, whichever came first, assessed up to 2 years.

otherOutcomes.description: Recurrence rate is defined as the proportion of the recurrence in the patients.
otherOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of randomization until the date of first documented progression or date of death from any cause, whichever came first, assessed up to 2 years.
